current.text: He is projected to start at power forward next to Nikola Jokic, with Jamal Murray, Christian Braun and Cam Johnson.
The depth behind him at power forward is called abysmal.
One expert expects Denver to be extra careful with his minutes.
He has looked great before the season.
Recent expert calls value him around pick 157 to 167 (round 14), and one expert avoids him in standard formats. He is only worth a look in deeper leagues.
He is seen as a streaming option who carries injury risk.
He turned 77% of his deflections into steals, against a 49% average. His steals are more likely to fall than rise.
Denver plays 43 games through March 28 and has only 14 back-to-backs, one of the lowest counts in the league.

durable.text: He has recurring soft tissue injuries in his lower body, including repeated hamstring and calf injuries, two years in a row.
Experts see him as a stable player with very little upside.
His steals and blocks are weak for a forward or center.

note: Gordon is at the bottom of the draft. Yahoo values him at 1 USD (rank 127), ESPN at 0 USD (rank 156), and he went for 2 USD in our league last season, while recent expert calls put him around picks 157 to 167, past our 144 drafted players. He fits punt STL and punt BLK builds, with a solid FG% (about 52% projected) and few turnovers, but he played only 36 games last season and has repeated hamstring and calf problems. Take him for 1 USD at most or leave him for waivers. Early on, check his minutes and his health.
